text: Tɛnigbe ɔ, tamɛlintɔ kplɔn yiji alavɔ doto zɔ kplɔn tɔ lɛ tɔn Stanford tɔn lɛ ɖɔ ye ja ɖe alinyan nu lanmɛ gbejegbeje kpɔn tɔn ɖokpo tɔn bɔ é na nɔn to wudjɔnu gbɛde kpɛvi bi agbaza tɔn lɛ: nu vu ɖe wɛ bɔ é hɛn ɔ é na yi gbɔn mɔ taglo mɛ sɔ gbe na yɛ kan mɛ kpodo akwɛ kpɛvidé kpan nu yi Amɛlika kwɛ ɖɔla kanɖe ɖokpo mɔ.
text_en: On Monday, scientists from the Stanford University School of Medicine announced the invention of a new diagnostic tool that can sort cells by type: a tiny printable chip that can be manufactured using standard inkjet printers for possibly about one U.S. cent each.

text: Dobanunù tɔ taji lɛ ɖɔ é hɛn ɔ ena zɔn bɔ è na yawu tuun nu kansɛ zɔn, kabi kpɛnwé zɔn, kabi sida zɔn, kabi hwésivɔ zɔn djɛ wɛ mɛdé de ɖo to é ma yi nukɔn ganji lɛ a è lobɔ gingan ɖo anɔn sin kansɛ zɔn nɔn hu taun é.
text_en: Lead researchers say this may bring early detection of cancer, tuberculosis, HIV and malaria to patients in low-income countries, where the survival rates for illnesses such as breast cancer can be half those of richer countries.

text: Gripen JAS 39C ɔ gba ɖo gan 9:30 zanzan ɖo ganxixo tɛn ɔ mɛ tɔn (0230 UTC) ɖo jɔmɛhunjayitɛn ɔ ji bo su jomɛhunjayitɛn ɔ nu jɔmɛhun ajɔ tɔn lɛ.
text_en: The JAS 39C Gripen crashed onto a runway at around 9:30 am local time (0230 UTC) and exploded, closing the airport to commercial flights.

text: Jɔmɛ hun kuntɔ ɔ é ko tun dɔ Squadron Leader Dilokrit Pattavee tɔn wɛ.
text_en: The pilot was identified as Squadron Leader Dilokrit Pattavee.

text: Xojlatɔ lɛ dɔ lɔkpa zocitɔ lɛ sin mɔnto ɖokpo fli ɖo azɔ yeṭɔn hwénu.
text_en: Local media reports an airport fire vehicle rolled over while responding.

text: Vidal ɖo xwe 28 bo byɔ Barça mɛ, nǔwiwá ɔ́ atɔn nɛ kó wá yi nɛ, bó gosín Séville tomɛ.
text_en: 28-year-old Vidal had joined Barça three seasons ago, from Sevilla.

text: Sín hwe e nu e Vidal wá Catalane tomɛ e ɔ́, bɔl'afɔsɔ́xo núwíwa 49 wɛ é xo nú bɔl'afɔsɔ́xó gbɛ́ ɔ́.
text_en: Since moving to the Catalan-capital, Vidal had played 49 games for the club.

text: Nǔwiwá ɔ́ bɛ́ ɖo Whitehall ji gan 11:00 ̀ mɔ̌, gan (UTC+1) tɔn kpan nukɔn gblotɛn e kponɔ Downing Street tɔn lɛ hɛn e. Fínɛ́ wɛ Gǎnhɔnyitɔ́ nukɔntɔn ɔ nɔ́ nɔ.
text_en: The protest started around 11:00 local time (UTC+1) on Whitehall opposite the police-guarded entrance to Downing Street, the Prime Minister's official residence.

text: Gan 11:00́ jɛn xo wa yi, bɔ mɛ e wa nǔwiwá ɔ́ tɛ́nmɛ lɛ́ é ján wayiwáyi ɖ'ali e ɖò totaligbe nú Whitehall e.
text_en: Just after 11:00, protesters blocked traffic on the northbound carriage in Whitehall.

text: É 11:20 ɔ, kponɔ lɛ ɖɔ nu mɛ e wá nǔwiwá ɔ́ tɛ́nmɛ lɛ e ɖɔ yě ni yi afɔzɔntɔ́-li ɔ́ jí, ɖɔ é jɛxá ɖɔ e ni mɔ̀ hwihwɛ ɖò nǔwiwá ɔ́ kpó gɔnu e ɖo na te zin wɛ e kpán.
text_en: At 11:20, the police asked the protesters to move back on to the pavement, stating that they needed to balance the right to protest with the traffic building up.

text: Gan 11:29 mɔ̌ ɔ, nuwiwá ɔ́ zín'agete bǐ zɛ Whitehall wu, gbɔn Trafalgar Square bó wá tɔ́n ɖo Strand, gbɔn Aldwych bó wá tɔ́n ɖo Kingsway jlɔ Holborn fí e toxóɖɔ́gbɛ́ hunjɛdonǔjitɔ ɔ́ nɔ́ ɖó kplé tɔn jlokokomɛ ninɔ tɔn ɖe ɖo aglasoésɔ́ɖójǐtɛn Grand Connaught Rooms e.
text_en: Around 11:29, the protest moved up Whitehall, past Trafalgar Square, along the Strand, passing by Aldwych and up Kingsway towards Holborn where the Conservative Party were holding their Spring Forum in the Grand Connaught Rooms hotel.

text: Akɔ́nta adǎnfúnfɔ́n Nadal kpó Canada kpán tɔ́n ɔ́ xlɛ́ 7-2.
text_en: Nadal's head to head record against the Canadian is 7–2.

text: É lɛ́ vɔ j'ayi kpé Raonic ɖò Open Brisbane tɔn.
text_en: He recently lost against Raonic in the Brisbane Open.

text: Nadal ɖù kɛ́n 88% ɖò bɔl'afɔsɔ́xo núwíwá ɔ́ mɛ bó lɛ ɖù 76 ɖ'azɔ̌ nukɔn tɔn ɔ mɛ.
text_en: Nadal bagged 88% net points in the match winning 76 points in the first serve.

text: É xò bɔlu ɔ́ fó ɔ́, ko King of Clay ɖɔ: "Awǎjijɛ wɛ gɔ́ mi ɖɔ un ko lɛ wa nǔwiwa taji lɛ sín vuvɔ nu. Un wa fí bó ná tɛ́nkpɔ́n ná ɖó ɖùɖ'éjí.”
text_en: After the match, King of Clay said, "I am just excited about being back in the final rounds of the most important events. I am here to try to win this."

text: "Panama papers" ɔ́, xó wɛ́ nyí b'ɛ nɔ ɖɔ do ɖe nyǐ wemǎ yi livi wǒ mɔ̌ é e ejlá ɖò xójláwémá tɛn ɖò Mossack Fonseca, hwɛɖɔtɔ́ gbásá Panama to ɔ́ tɔn. Avuvɔ hwenu xwe 2016́ tɔ́n.
text_en: "Panama Papers" is an umbrella term for roughly ten million documents from Panamanian law firm Mossack Fonseca, leaked to the press in spring 2016.

text: Wěma ɖelɛ́ ɖexlɛ́ ɖɔ akwɛsɛxwetɛn wǒ- ɛnɛ d'alɔ dɔkunnɔ gegě bɔ yě hwla dɔkun Dɔla Amɛlika tɔn liva wɔbu-wɔ́bú dó gbɔ takwɛ kpodo gbetakɛ́n ɖevo lɛ.
text_en: The documents showed fourteen banks helped wealthy clients hide billions of US dollars of wealth to avoid taxes and other regulations.

text: Glɛnsito sín xójláwémágɔ́nu The Guadian ɖɔ̀ Deutsh Bank wɛ dó do azɔ̌xwé 1200 yé zan bo do kpéwú bo dowà nu enɛ .
text_en: British newspaper The Guardian suggested Deutsche Bank controlled roughly a third of the 1200 shell companies used to accomplish this.

text: Gbɛtakɛ́n súsɔ́ gegě tíìn ɖo gbɛ ɔ́ mɛ, hwɛsɛ́n bɔ ɖó nú mɛ gegě tin nyǐ bɔ togan Iceland tomɛ tɔn ɔ́ kpó Pakistan tomɛ tɔn ɔ́ kpó wè lɛ bǐ wɛ gbɛ́ tɛn e mɛ yé ɖè ɔ.
text_en: There were protests worldwide, several criminal prosecutions, and the leaders of the governments of Iceland and Pakistan both resigned.

text: Ma ɔ́, e ji'i ɖò Hong Kong b'ɛ́ yi azɔ̌mɛ ɖò kplɔ́nyijǐ alavɔ New York tɔn ɖ'ala e nɔ wa sɛnzɔ́ Harvard tɔn. É kó ɖó wemakoéwún e ylɔ ɖɔ "Carte Verte" fí nunɔ titeungbe Amerika to ɔ́ tɔ́n.
text_en: Born in Hong Kong, Ma studied at New York University and Harvard Law School and once held an American permanent resident "green card".

text: Sɔmisɔmi hwénú ɔ́, mɛɖaxó Hsieh ɖɔ mɛɖaxó Ma hɛn ɔ́ é ná hɔn sín to ɔ́ mɛ zigidi hwènu.
text_en: Hsieh implied during the election that Ma might flee the country during a time of crisis.

text: Hsieh lɛ vɔ xlɛ́ ɖɔ yɛzɔ̌ wa tɔ́ Ma ɖǒ wlɛnwín ɖagbe b'ɛ́ vɛ́ jlɛ́
text_en: Hsieh also argued that the photogenic Ma was more style than substance.

text: Kpó hwɛ do mɛ lɛ ɖè ɔ́, Ma ɖo ɖuɖeji ɖò tuto ɖe mɛ b'ɛ́ ɖó mimamɛ trɔlɔ xá Chine to ɔ́.
text_en: Despite these accusations, Ma won handily on a platform advocating closer ties with the Chinese mainland.

text: Bɔluxotɔ́ azǎn ɔ́ jí tɔ́n wɛ́ nyí Alex Ovechkin Washington tomɛ tɔn.
text_en: Today's Player of the Day is Alex Ovechkin of the Washington Capitals.

text: E do bíii 2 bó s'aji mimɛ 2 ɖo ɖuɖeji 5 - 3 Washington tɔn ɖò Thrashers Atlanta tɔn ji
text_en: He had 2 goals and 2 assists in Washington's 5-3 win over the Atlanta Thrashers.

text: Ovechkin sín bɔlu na mɛ nukɔn tɔn ɔ́ tíin nyǐ ɖo ɖuɖeji Nicklas Backstrom tɔn mɛ.
text_en: Ovechkin's first assist of the night was on the game-winning goal by rookie Nicklas Backstrom;

text: Bíii tɔn wegɔ gbadanu nɛ tɔn ɔ́ wɛ́ nyí 60 gɔ ɔ n'ii ɖò nǔwiwà ɔ́ mɛ, b'ɛ́ húzú bɔluxotɔ́ nukɔn tɔn e do bíii 60 ɖo bɔluxuxo nuwiwá ɖokpó mɛ é sín 1995-96 mɛ e Jaromir Jagr kpó Mario Lemieux kpán yi hǎ nɛ ji e.
text_en: his second goal of the night was his 60th of the season, becoming the first player to score 60 or more goals in a season since 1995-96, when Jaromir Jagr and Mario Lemieux each reached that milestone.

text: E tò mɛɖaxó Batten ɖò 190 gɔ ɖò Amelika-vi dɔkùn ɖaxónɔ 400 xwe 2008 gɔ ɔ mɛ kpó dɔkùn lǐva 2,3 kpán.
text_en: Batten was ranked 190th on the 2008 400 Richest Americans list with an estimated fortune of $2.3 billion.

text: É eɖó kúnnúɖewémá ɖo College of Arts & Sciences kplɔ́nyiji alavɔ Virginie tɔn ɖò xwe 1950 mɛ bó nyí nǔnamɛtɔ́ titeungbe xwé nɛ́ tɔ́n
text_en: He graduated from the College of Arts & Sciences of the University of Virginia in 1950 and was a significant donor to that institution.

text: Irak sín gankpámɛ e ɖó Abu Ghraib wlǐ zo ɖó adǎnfúnfɔ́n ɖé mɛ.
text_en: Iraq's Abu Ghraib prison has been set alight during a riot.

text: Gankpá ɔ́ wa kú awi bǐ bó kpé to é e acɛ gba gantɔ́ lɛ́ wú xó wá tɔ́n hwe e nu e ahwangan Amerika tɔn lɛ wa xɔ to e.
text_en: The jail became notorious after prisoner abuse was discovered there after US forces took over.

text: Piquet Jr j'ayǐ ɖ'ajɔ ɖaxó Singapour tɔn xwe 2008 gɔ ɔ tɔ́n mɛ hwe e nu é nɔ te ɖokpó ɖò Fernando sín gɔnu bó ɖe ayij'ayǐ zohun tɔ́n é.
text_en: Piquet Jr. crashed in the 2008 Singapore Grand Prix just after an early pit stop for Fernando Alonso, bringing out the safety car.

text: Hwe e nu e mɔ̌to lɛ ɖo Alonso nukɔn xwè ami yi gbé ɖò ayij'ayǐ zohun ɔ́ glɔ́ é ɔ́, é ɖè kpɛ́n tɔ́n bó ɖó ɖuɖeji.
text_en: As the cars ahead of Alonso went in for fuel under the safety car, he moved up the pack to take victory.

text: E yi azɔ̌ sín Piquet Jr. sí ajɔ ɖaxó Hongrie tɔn xwe afɔwo tɛ́nnɛ gɔ ɔ (2009) mɛ.
text_en: Piquet Jr. was sacked after the 2009 Hungarian Grand Prix.

text: É xo gàn 8:46 zanzan pɛ́pɛ́pɛ́ b'abɔ̌ xwíí ɖé jɛ to ɔ ji bó xlɛ́ ɖò hwe enɛ nu pɛ́ɛ́ wɛ jɔmɛhun nukɔntɔn e yì xò nǔ ye tɔ́n ahwan é.
text_en: At exactly 8:46 a.m. a hush fell across the city, marking the exact moment the first jet struck its target.

text: E wa sɔ́ ahwanlinnyanu myɔgbɛn nɔ atɔn junjɔn'ayǐ jlɔ́ jixwé zǎnmɛ.
text_en: Two beams of light have been rigged up to point skywards overnight.

text: E ɖo xɔ̀ joglisó yɔyɔ̌ atɔ́ɔ́n gbá ɖó tɛn ɔ́, hɔnkàn tɛnsisɛ tɔn kpó sɔ́ flĭn jikpá dokpo do tɛntin ɔ.
text_en: Construction is ongoing for five new skyscrapers at the site, with a transportation center and memorial park in the middle.

text: E d'ajɔ Emmy tɔn tùto televizion ji tɔn e yin PBS e hú kó nukún ɛnɛ, tutò ɔ sin ga kà sɔ hú ɖevo lɛ tɔn ɖi “Sesame street” kpo “Mister Rogers Neighborhood” kpo a.
text_en: The PBS show has more than two-dozen Emmy awards, and its run is shorter only than Sesame Street and Mister Rogers' Neighborhood.

text: Akpáxwé tutò ɔ tɔn lɛ dokpò dokpò nɔ kɛnu dó xóta ɖé ji ɖò wema ɖokpo mɛ, enɛ ɔ gudó ɔ é nɔ wa gbéjè xotà ɔ kpɔn gbɔn tàn gègě ɖèvo lɛ gblamɛ.
text_en: Each episode of the show would focus on a theme in a specific book and then explore that theme through multiple stories.

text: Tùto lɛ dòkpo dòkpo nɔ lɛ na alixlɛ́mɛ lɛ ɖò wema ɖědee vì lɛ ɖo na bà hwenu e ye yi wemaxaxɔsa yetɔn e.
text_en: Each show would also provide recommendations for books that children should look for when they went to their library.

text: John Grant ee nɔ wazɔ ɖo WNED buffalo (televisioǹxwé e nɔ blo Tutò televizion ji tɔn "Reading Rainbow") e ɖɔ: “Reading Rainbow" kplɔn vì lɛ nǔ e wutu e ɖò na xà nu e,...kplɔn ye wanyiyi nú nùxixa — [Tuto ɔ] lɛ dó wusyɛn lanmɛ nú ye bonu ye ni sɔ wema bo jɛ xixa ji”.
text_en: John Grant, from WNED Buffalo (Reading Rainbow's home station) said "Reading Rainbow taught kids why to read,... the love of reading — [the show] encouraged kids to pick up a book and to read."

text: Mɛ ɖé lɛ, ɖì John Grant ɖɔhun ɖò linlin wɛ ɖɔ akwɛ yozo kpo huzuhuzu e wà tɔn ɖò lee mɛ lɛ nɔ lin tutò televizion ji tɔn lɛ kpɔ gbɔn e ɔ ɖò nu e zɔn bɔ e ɖò tutò ɔ te.
text_en: It is believed by some, including John Grant, that both the funding crunch and a shift in the philosophy of educational television programming contributed to ending the series.

text: Xó e nǔmɔɖɔ ɖ'ayǐ tɔ́ lɛ́ ɖɔ e adǎnjɔhɔn éé ɖò aliga 645 miles mɔ (1040 km)ɖò gbadahwe ji nú tɔgwede Cap-Vert tɔn, ɖo na fá hwɛ̌ có bó ná xo nǔ e ɖ'ayikúngban ɔ́ ji lɛ e.
text_en: The storm, situated about 645 miles (1040 km) west of the Cape Verde islands, is likely to dissipate before threatening any land areas, forecasters say.

text: Fred ɖo jɔhɔn 105 miles ganxixo ɖokpó mɛ (165km/h) bó nɔ́ yi gbadahweji sín vovolívoé.
text_en: Fred currently has winds of 105 miles per hour (165 km/h) and is moving towards the northwest.

text: Fred wɛ nyi jɔhɔn ɖaxó ɖaxó bǐ é è e ma mɔ kpɔ́n gbeɖe ɖò tofɔligbe kpó zǎnzǎnhweji Atlantique tɔn kpán sín hwe e nu yɛkpɔ́n ɖo kanji gɔnu ɔ wa e, bó nyí jɔhɔn ɖaxó atɔn gɔ e ̀e mɔ ɖò zǎnzǎnhweji ɖo 35°W e.
text_en: Fred is the strongest tropical cyclone ever recorded so far south and east in the Atlantic since the advent of satellite imagery, and only the third major hurricane on record east of 35°W.

text: Azǎn 24 gɔɔ zǒsùn xwe 1759 tɔn ɔ́, Arthur Guinness d'ayi wemǎ xwe 9000 tɔn ɖe mɛ nú ahànxwé St James' Gate tɔn ɖo Dublin ɖo Irlande tomɛ.
text_en: On September 24, 1759, Arthur Guinness signed a 9,000 year lease for the St James' Gate Brewery in Dublin, Ireland.

text: Xwe 250 wayi gúdó ɔ́, Guinness wa huzu azɔ̌xwe ɖaxó bó vlɔ́n ada gbɔ̀n gbɛ ɔ bǐ mɛ bó nɔ́ mɔ akwɛ́ yi 10 billion euros (US$14.7 billion) xwe ɖokpó mɛ.
text_en: 250 years later, Guinness has grown to a global business that turns over 10 billion euros (US$14.7 billion) every year.

text: Jonny Reid e ɖò gɔ̀nu A1GP Nouvelle-Zélande nu é kùn yě wùnna-wúnná yi anǎ agbanj'ayǐ-tɛn Auckland tɔn ɖò Nouvelle-Zélande, mɛxó xwe 48 mɛ tɔn, ɖò sɛ́n lixo .
text_en: Jonny Reid, co-driver for the A1GP New Zealand team, today made history by driving the fastest over the 48-year-old Auckland Harbour Bridge, New Zealand, legally.

text: Mɛɖaxó Reid kpéwú bó kùn mɔ̌to Néo-Zélande tɔn A1GP, Black Beauty é agbɔ̌n-wezùn tɔn hú aliga kɛnnɛ ganxuxo ɖokpó mɛ (160km/h) azɔn tɛ́nwe ɖ'anǎ ɔ ji e.
text_en: Mr Reid managed to drive the New Zealand's A1GP car, Black Beauty at speeds over 160km/h seven times over the bridge.

text: Kponɔ Néo-Zélande tɔn lɛ mɔ wǔvɛ dó zán mɔ̀ do tuùn agbɔ̌n-wezùn mɛɖaxó Reid tɔn, ɖó Black Beauty ɔ ɖò do tawun bɔ azɔn ɖokpó e Kponɔ lɛ kpéwú bó lɛn ganmɛ nú mɛɖaxó Reid e ɔ́, hwe e nu e é nɔ te ɖ'agbɔ̌n-wezùn kɛnnɛ ganxuxo ɖokpó mɛ (160km/h) é wɛ.
text_en: The New Zealand police had trouble using their speed radar guns to see how fast Mr Reid was going because of how low Black Beauty is, and the only time the police managed to clock Mr Reid was when he slowed down to 160km/h.

text: Sùnzǎn 3 gudotɔn elɔ lɛ mɛ ɔ́, mɛɖohwɛnu ma wli xwédó sɛ́n 80 jɛji wɛ e jo nyi te ɖo Central Booking.
text_en: In the last 3 months, over 80 arrestees were released from the Central Booking facility without being formally charged.

text: Ɖò lidosùn xwe élɔ́ tɔ́n mɛ ɔ́, Hwɛɖɔtɔ́ Glynn ɖe mɛglɔn-wema nǔ hwenu ɖe tɔ́n jlɔ́ azɔ̌xwé ɔ́ nu yě na jó mɛ è e wlǐ bɔ yě kó bló ɖo ganxixo 24 mɛ bɔ kponɔngǎn ɖee ma ká kó se xó ɖé ɖo nù yětɔn ǎ e.
text_en: In April this year, a temporary restaining order was issued by Judge Glynn against the facility to enforce the release of those held more than 24 hours after their intake who did not receive a hearing by a court commissioner.

text: Kponɔgan ɔ́ na gǎnjɛwú ɖé, nú é nyí mɔ̌ bó ɖe kúnnú nú hwɛdǒmɛ e mɛwlitɔ́ ɔ́ ɖɔ lɛ́ é. E na cí agban lɛ ji ɖ'axɔ́súxwé fí è kpé nukún xó nɛ́ wú ɖe wɛ e ɖe e.
text_en: The commissioner sets bail, if granted, and formalizes the charges filed by the arresting officer. The charges are then entered into the state's computer system where the case is tracked.

text: Xógún ɔ́ lɛ vɔ ná nǔ mɔ ɖɔ dó mɛ wu nú hwɛɖuɖɔ sín azǎn ɔ́.
text_en: The hearing also marks the date for the suspect’s right to a speedy trial.

text: Peter Costello akwɛ́gbajinɔtɔ́ Australie tɔn et lɛ nyí nya e hɛn na jɛ hɔnyitɔ́ nukɔn tɔn ɔ́ John Howard e ɖo ta nu jlokoko-toxóɖɔgbɛ tɛ́nmɛ́ é, gɔ́ alɔ nu mɔ jangin-jangin xwé ɖé ɖo Australie.
text_en: Peter Costello, Australian treasurer and the man most likely to succeed Prime Minister John Howard as Liberal party leader has thrown his support behind a nuclear power industry in Australia.

text: Mɛɖaxó Costello ɖɔ hwe e nu myɔ s'ágbɔ̌n zɔ ɔ na wá jɛ akwɛ́ ná ji e ɔ́ Australie to ɔ na jɛ zinzan ji.
text_en: Mr Costello said that when nuclear power generation becomes economically viable, Australia should pursue its use.

text: "Nú é huzu nǔsátɛ́n ɔ́, mǐ ɖo na ɖó e bó ná zán", mɛɖaxó Costello wɛ ɖɔ mɔ̌.
text_en: "If it becomes commercial, we should have it. That is, there's no in-principle objection to nuclear energy" Mr Costello said.

text: Xó e Ansa ɖɔ e wɛ nyi ɖɔ "adò hu kponɔ lɛ do gǎn ɖaxó wè ye hu sixu zon bɔ ahwan nan bɛ dó gǎn yɔyɔ̌ ye jló na sɔ́ wutu.
text_en: According to Ansa, "police were concerned by a couple of top-level hits they feared might spark a full-blown war of succession.

text: Ɖò kponɔ lɛ sín linlín mɛ ɔ́, Lo Piccolo ɖò nukɔn tawun ɖó é wɛ́ nyí alɔsú Provenzano tɔn ɖò Palerme bɔ nǔmɔjɛnǔmɛ tɔn zɔ́n bɔ̀ e nɔ ɖo sísí ɖaxó é jɛ xá gǎn e nɔ wlɛnwlin Provenzo tɔn e nɔ nɔ̀ yɛmɛ bó kɔ́n nɔ́ ɖo nǔ ɖa wɛ e.
text_en: Police said Lo Piccolo had the upper hand because he had been Provenzano's right-hand man in Palermo and his greater experience won him the respect of the older generation of bosses as they pursued Provenzano's policy of keeping as low as possible while strengthening their power network.

text: Gǎn e nɛ lɛ ɔ́, Provenzano wɛ ɖà yě hwe e nu é ɖó ahwantɔ́nmɛ Riina tɔn jlɔ Acɛkpikpa ɔ te e. Ahwan nɛ e dɔn kú wá é, Giovanni Falcone kpó Paolo Borsellino kpán ɖo xwe 1992 mɛ.
text_en: These bosses had been reined in by Provenzano when he put an end to the Riina-driven war against the state that claimed the lives of Mafia crusaders Giovanni Falcone and Paolo Borsellino in 1992."

text: Apple sín gǎn ɔ nɔ, Steve Jobs ɖe alǒkán ɔ́ tɔ́n ɖo to nukɔn bó ɖè Iphone ɔ́ sín jǐnu tɔn sín akpò mɛ.
text_en: Apple CEO Steve Jobs unveiled the device by walking onto the stage and taking the iPhone out of his jeans pocket.

text: Hwe e nu é ɖò xó è ɖɔ̀ nu ganxuxo 2 e ɖɔ wɛ e ɔ, é ɖɔ: "Égbé ɔ́, Apple na vɔ́ alǒkan ɔ́ ɖétɔ́n, mǐ na byɔ hwenuxó mɛ égbe".
text_en: During his 2 hour speech he stated that "Today Apple is going to reinvent the phone, We are going to make history today".

text: Bresil wɛ nyí Igleja Katolika to ɖaxó é ɖò gbɛ ɔ mɛ e. Igleja Katolika nɔ ko gbɛ̌ kpɔ́jíjɛ súnnù-súnnù tɔ́n ɔ́ sɔ́ xwédó sɛ́n tɛgbɛ.
text_en: Brazil is the largest Roman Catholic country on Earth, and the Roman Catholic Church has consistently opposed the legalization of same-sex marriage in the country.

text: Kplégɔnu ɖaxó Bresil tɔn ɔ́ ɖo xò ɖɔ dó kpɔ́jíjɛ súnnú-súnnú tɔ́n ɔ́ wú wɛ sín xwe wǒ (10ans) ɖye bɔ alɔwliwlí nɛ ɖ'axɔ́sú gɔ́n ɔ́, Rio Grande do Sul kpán jɛ́ é xwé dí sɛ́n ɖe.
text_en: The National Congress of Brazil has debated legalization for 10 years, and such civil marriages are currently only legal in Rio Grande do Sul.

text: Tokpɔnlagǎn xóxó São Paulo, kpó Marta Suplicy koán wɛ́ wlán sɛ́n wéma dodo ɔ́. Sɛ́n wú ɖ'alɔ bo wa sɔ́ sɛ́n ɔ́, é ɖo Roberto Jefferson si' alɔ mɛ.
text_en: The original bill was drafted by former mayor of São Paulo, Marta Suplicy. The proposed legislation, after being amended, is now in the hands of Roberto Jefferson.

text: Mɛ e jɔ wǔ do nǔ nɛ mɛ lɛ e ɖò lìnlìn wɛ na yi nǔbyɔbyɔ́ lǐvi 1.2 do yi xwlé Kplé-gɔnu ɖaxó Bresil tɔn ɔ abɔxwísùn ɔ́ mɛ.
text_en: Protesters hope to collect a petition of 1.2 million signatures to present to the National Congress in November.

text: É e mɔ ɖɔ̀ hɛ̌nnu gegě ɖo hwɛgbasa sín alɔgɔ ba wɛ na dó liza xá mɛ nya sín tomɛ e ɔ́, e ylɔ kplé ɖé azǎn 20 gɔ xwejisùn ɔ́ tɔ́n mɛ ɖò East Bay Community Law Center nú mɛ e ajo gbo ɖòbfí e yě ɖe lɛ e.
text_en: After it became apparent that many families were seeking legal help to fight the evictions, a meeting was held on March 20 at the East Bay Community Law Center for the victims of the housing scam.

text: É e xɔxáyatɔ́ lɛ́ jɛ nǔ e xá yě lɛ e jlá jí e ɔ́, hɛnnu e nǔ nɛ kan lɛ e gegě mɔ ɖɔ Carolyn Wilson OHA tɔn ko cí akwɛ́ e yě sɔ́ ɖó gbanu e ji bó ko gosín to ɔ mɛ.
text_en: When the tenants started sharing what had occurred to them, most of the families involved suddenly realized that Carolyn Wilson of the OHA had stolen their security deposits, and skipped out of town.

text: Xɔxáyatɔ́ Lockwood Garden tɔn lɛ mɔ ɖɔ̀ e siǐ kó lɛ nya hɛ̌nnu 40 jɛji ɖěvo lɛ, ɖó yě se ɖɔ kponɔ OHA tɔn lɛ ɖò do ba nu nǔ wɛ dó Oakland sín xɔ̀ ɖěvo e mɛ wɛ mɛwloɖu hɛn na tɔ́n ɖé mɛ lɛ e.
text_en: Tenants at Lockwood Gardens believe that there may be another 40 families or more to face eviction, since they learned that OHA police are also investigating other public housing properties in Oakland that may be caught up in the housing scam.

text: Gbɛ̌tá ɔ́ gbɛ́ aɖawun nuwiwa e ɖò War Memorial Staddium, Maoui tɔn, e ɖó na kplé gbɛtɔ́ 9000 bó ɖò súsɔkɛ byɔ́ mɛ e ko lin na wa lɛ e bǐ wɛ.
text_en: The band canceled the show at Maui's War Memorial Stadium, which was set to be attended by 9,000 people, and apologized to fans.

text: Azɔ̌xwé nukún é nɔ́ kpé nukún gbɛta ɔ wu e, HK Management Inc, nyɔ́ hwɛ na klɔ́n azǎn 20 gɔ zǒsùn ɔ tɔn ǎ, amɔ̌ é wa tín nǔ e wú wɛ zɔ́n lɛ́ e ayihɔngbe tɔn.
text_en: The band's management company, HK Management Inc., gave no initial reason when they canceled on September 20, but blamed logistical reasons by the next day.

text: È sɔ́ hwɛɖɔtɔ́ nukúnɖeji Glɛ̌ki nu Sakis Kechagioglou kpó George Nikolakopoulos kpán dó Korydallus gan mɛ ɖò Athènes, ɖó yě nɔ nǔɖuɖonǔmɛ mɛ.
text_en: The famous Greek lawyers, Sakis Kechagioglou and George Nikolakopoulos have been imprisoned in the Athens' jail of Korydallus, as they were found guilty of graft and corruption.

text: Lo ɔ́, nǔ ma xwe do sɛ́n e hwɛɖɔtɔ,́ kpó hùnjɛmɛji tɔ́, kpó sɛ́nzɔwatɔ́ glɛ̌ki tɔn ɖelɛ́ kpán do te xwe e wayi e mɛ e dɔn zigidi ɖaxó ɖé wá hwɛɖɔtɔ́ mɛ nɛ lɛ mɛ.
text_en: As a result of this, a big scandal within the Greek legal community has been raised through the exposure of illegal actions that judges, lawyers, solicitors and attorneys have done during the previous years.

text: É e xójlázɔ́watɔ́ Makis Triantafylopoulos jla wɛn ɖe do nǔwiwa "Zoungla" mɛ ɖo gbavinukpɛ́nɔgɔnu Alpha TV ji ɔ, é bló aklúnɔ́zángbla nabǐ ɖe mɔ̌ bɔ e ɖe ɖɛmɛnu hunjɛmɛjitɔ́ Petos Mantouvalos sin azɔ̌ tɔn mɛ ɖó azɔ̌gbɛ tɔn ɖélɛ́ ɖó nǔ ɖò nǔɖuɖònǔmɛ xó ɔ́ mɛ.
text_en: A few weeks ago, after the information published by the journalist Makis Triantafylopoulos in his popular Television show "Zoungla" in Alpha TV, the member of Parliament and lawyer, Petros Mantouvalos was abdicated as members of his office had been involved in illegal graft and corruption.

text: Lo ɔ, hwɛɖɔtɔ́ ɖaxó Evangelos Kalousis ɖo ganmɛ ɖó é tɔ́n ɖò nǔɖuɖonǔmɛ mɛ bó lɛ ɖè afɔ gbkegblé.
text_en: Moreover, top judge Evangelos Kalousis is imprisoned as he found guilty of corruption and degenerate behaviour.

text: Roberts gbɛ́ bǐ gbidi-gbidi ɖɔ émí kún ná ɖɔ hwe e è nu e gbɛ nɔ bɛ nú e gbeje xo è e ɖe e kpɔ́n é o, bó ɖɔ é hɛ́n ɔ́ é ná wa nyí xó agɔ̀ dó nu e wa yi ɖò xo e ɖe wayi e wu nú e na ɖɔ̀ xó dó nǔ e sixú tíin lɛ e wú.
text_en: Roberts flatly refused to say about when he believes life begins, an important question when considering the ethics of abortion, saying that it would be unethical to comment on the specifics of likely cases.

text: É lɛ́ vɔ́ wá xó e é ɖɔ ɖ'áyǐ e jí ɖɔ Roe V. Wade wɛ nyi "sɛ́n e To ɔ sɔ́ é", bó ɖò nǔjɔnǔ e gbetakɛ́n To gɔnu ɖaxó ɔ́ tɔ́n nyi e tínmɛ wɛ.
text_en: He did, however, reiterate his earlier statement that Roe v. Wade was the "settled law of the land", emphasizing the importance of consistent Supreme Court rulings.

text: É lɛ́ vɔ́ ɖɔ é mí gán jɛ sɛ́n e ɖɔ nǔ do gbetakɛ́n Roe tɔn ji e wu.
text_en: He also confirmed that he believed in the implied right to privacy which the Roe decision depended upon.

text: Maroochydore wɛ nyi tatɔ ɖò titɔ ɔ mɛ kpodo kɛn ayizin hûgan Noosa, awhé tɔ ɖò titɔ ɔ mɛ
text_en: Maroochydore had finished on top of the ladder, six points clear of Noosa in second.

text: Gbɛ̌ta awhé lɛ́ɛ ɔ kplé ɖò fìfɔ tɛn apkawhé nûkɔn tɔn ɔn tajì ɔ fìe gbɛ̌ta Noosa ɖò ɖuɖéji kpoɖò kɛn 11 kpó.
text_en: The two sides would meet in the major semi final where Noosa ran out winners by 11 points.

text: Maroochydore lɛ́ɛ ɖuɖé ji mɔn ɖo Caboolture ji nu agbawlin wlin nukɔn tɔn ɔn.
text_en: Maroochydore then defeated Caboolture in the Preliminary Final.

text: Hesperonychus elizabethae ɔ kunkan Dromaeosauridae mɛ e egósin bò lɛ́ɛ nyi nɔnvi nu Velociraptor.
text_en: Hesperonychus elizabethae is a species of the family Dromaeosauridae and is a cousin of Velociraptor .

text: Nûwliɖuxɛ ɖé e nɔn ɖu hunkanlin lɛ́ɛ ɔ fun keɖè wɛ gbɔn fi bi nii bɔ ehɛn na zinzɔnlin gbɔn afɔ awhé ji ɔ kpodò fɛn pkèvi ɖi Velociraptor.
text_en: This fully feathered, warm blooded bird of prey was believed to have walked upright on two legs with claws like the Velociraptor.

text: Fɛn awhé tɔ ɔ ɖi ga kaka, enɛ wê zɔn bò esu nyiɖɔ Hesperonychus tinmê tɔn nyiɖɔ "yovo fɛn".
text_en: Its second claw was larger, giving rise to the name Hesperonychus which means "western claw."

text: Ninnɔnmɛ gbê ɔ mɛ tɔn zɔ́n bɔ mɛhwlɛn hwlɛn sin azɔ lɛ vɛhu ɖésu, xù mɛ glǎsi-ɛ́ɛ ɖé e nɔ gbà lɔ mɔn.
text_en: In addition to the crushing ice, extreme weather conditions have been hampering rescue efforts.

text: Pitman tin mɛ ɖɔ ninnɔnmɛ lɛ́ɛ man na ɖiɔ ɖò azán gbla elɔ mɛ.
text_en: Pittman suggested that conditions wouldn't improve until sometime next week.

text: Dò Pitman xó ɖìɖɔ mɛ ɔn, Xù mɛ glǎsi-ɛ́ɛ ɔ susu etɔn kpodô adà gblogblo e tɔn kpo ɔ ma hlan sɔ mɔn gbéɖé nu tɔjihun lɛ́ɛ sin xwè 15 ɖié.
text_en: The amount and thickness of the pack ice, according to Pittman, is the worst it has been for sealers in the past 15 years.

text: Égbé hwenu e é ɖò ciɔ Jeff Weise tɔn ɖì wɛ kpo mɛ aton ɖevó ɖò mɛ tɛnnɛ e kú ɖo tú e é dà ɖò azɔ yetɔn mɛ ɖo azan 21 gɔ ɔ xwèjisùn ɔ tɔn mɛ wɛ ɔ, é lɛ wli ɖókpo ɖò azɔmɛvi e ɖ'alɔ ɖò túdida ɔ mɛ lɛ, bɔ wɛn ɔ bgakpe kplekple Red Lake mɛ lɛ tɔn mɛ.
text_en: News spread in the Red Lake community today as funerals for Jeff Weise and three of the nine victims were held that another student was arrested in connection with the school shootings of March 21.

text: Acɛkpipka ɔ sɔ ɖɔ xó ɖé zɛ gbè e é yí ɖɔ émi ɖó mɛ ɔ te égbé́ e wu a.
text_en: Authorities said little officially beyond confirming today's arrest.

text: E ɖò mǒ có, mɛ e mɔ dò nú dòbànú nǔ ɔ e ɖé ɖɔ nú xójlawemà Minneapolis Star-tribune ɖɔ, mɛ e éɖò te ɔ vǐ sunú ɖé dò xwè fɔtɔn nukún ɖokpo bo nɔn nyi Floyd Jourdain dé sin tɔ́ nyi azinkponɔn nú akɔta Red Lake tɔn ɔ wɛ.
text_en: However, a source with knowledge of the investigation told the Minneapolis Star-Tribune that it was Louis Jourdain, 16-year old son of Red Lake Tribal Chairman Floyd Jourdain.

text: Mǐ kó tùn hwɛ e sà dó kɔ ni gbe é ja e a, kpó lee acɛkpikpa bló gbɔn bo mɔ yanviɔ kpó e a, amǒ afɔ e é nɔ ɖè nú yɔkpɔvu e ma kó ɖó xwè 18 a jɛ whɛ syɛnsyɛn mɛ e ɖé kó bɛ ɖò whɛɖɔxɔsa ɖé núkɔn.
text_en: It is not known at this time what charges will be laid or what led authorities to the boy but juvenile proceedings have begun in federal court.

text: Lodin lɛ́ ɖɔ jí, gɑ̌n lɛ́,e sɔ́ gběta ná dɔn nǔ gbɔn gǎnsísɔ́ sín akpáxwé wegɔ ɔ́ jí, bó ná dó ɖe Afuganisitáannu lɛ́ɛ sín afɔku e mɛ gǎnsísɔ́ ɖěvo énɛ́ ɔ́ hɛn ɔ́, é ná dɔn yě dó lɛ́ɛ é, bó ḱ ná lɛ́ zɔ́n bɔ yě sɔ́ ná wá ɖo kwɛ́ zán dó xo ayij’ayí kan ná wɛ ǎ.
text_en: Lodin also said officials decided to cancel the runoff in order to save Afghans the expense and security risk of another election.

text: Afɔsɔ́dɔtetɔ́ lɛ́ɛ ɖɔ émi mɔ nǔjɛdó gěgě ɖo sɛ́ndódó Afuganisitáan to ɔ́ tɔn mɛ, bɔ énɛ́ ɔ́ zɔ́n bɔ gansísɔ́ sín akpaxwé we gɔ ɔ́, sɔ́ nyi nǔɖé wá nú ǎ.
text_en: Diplomats said that they had found enough ambiguity in the Afghan constitution to determine the runoff as unnecessary.

text: Dobanú nǔ ɖé lɛ́ɛ ka ko ɖɔ d’ayi ɖɔ jí, ényí é ko dɔn nǔ gbɔn gǎnsisɔ́ sín akpáxwé we gɔ ɔ́ jí wɛ ɔ́, efɔ wɛ é ná kó nyi bɔ é tɛ sɛ́dódó ɔ́ jí.
text_en: This contradicts earlier reports, which said that cancelling the runoff would have been against the constitution.

text: Totɛntín sín ahwanzɔwatɔ́ lɛ́ɛ wɛ ɖo jɔmɛhún ɔ́ kún wɛ, bɔ yě dlɔ́n dó Ilukusiki.
text_en: The aircraft had been headed to Irkutsk and was being operated by interior troops.

text: É hun nǔ sín dobanú nǔ wíwa ɖokpó nú.
text_en: An inquiry was established to investigate.

text: Jɔmɛhún II-76 ɔ́, alǐyánnu ɖaxó ɖokpo wɛ ényi nú ahwangɔnu Hluísí to ɔ́ kpódó sovǐtiki kpó tɔn, sín xwe 1970 gblólomɛ dɔn, bó ka ko bló alitawǒvi ɖaxó ɖé ɖo Hluísi to ɔ́ mɛ, sunzán é wáyi e mɛ.
text_en: The Il-76 has been a major component of both the Russian and Soviet military since the 1970s, and had already seen a serious accident in Russia last month.

text: Kɔ́nyásun ɔ́ sín azǎn 7 gɔ́, mɔ ɖokpó sɛ sín do tɔn mɛ, hwenu e jɔmɛhún ɔ́ ɖo te sí wɛ dó é, mɛ ɖěbǔ ka gbléwu ǎ. Énɛ́ gudó ɔ́ Hluísí to ɔ́ wá gbɛ́ nú hwenu kléwún ɖé ɖɔ jɔmɛhun II-76 lɛ́ɛ ɖe má sɔ́ síte ó.
text_en: On October 7 an engine separated on takeoff, without injuries. Russia briefly grounded Il-76s after that accident.

text: Miles 800 atɔ e nɔ dɔn ami gbɔn domɛ d’asá Alaska to ɔ́ tɔn é wɛ é sú, hwenu kalozíin bluju sín balíi afatɔ́ɔn donu mɔkpán kɔn nyì ayǐ do tofɔligbé Fairbanks toxo ɔ́ ɖo Alaska tó ɔ́ mɛ.
text_en: 800 miles of the Trans-Alaska Pipeline System were closed down following a spill of thousands of barrels of crude oil south of Fairbanks, Alaska.

text: Tito e nɔ dogesí zojinǔ é, gbéjékpɔ́n wɛ é ɖe, lěe é ko nɔ bló gbɔn hwɛhwɛ é, bɔ zogbɛ́nhlɔ́nhlɔ́n ɔ́ ci. Énɛ́ ɔ́ zɔ́n bɔ nusú éé nɔ glɔ́n kalozíin bluju ɔ́ lɛ́ɛ é hun, bɔ é gba kɔn dó nɔtɛn e é nɔ gbɔn ami ɖe, bɔ é ylɔ́ ɖɔ Fort Greely 9 é.
text_en: A power failure following a routine fire-command system test caused relief valves to open and crude oil overflowed near the Fort Greely pump station 9.

text: Nusú énɛ́ lɛ́ɛ e hun é, zɔ́n bɔ kɔgbidinúmɛ é tɔ́n é ɔ bló bɔ ami ɔ́ jɛ kunkun jí, bó sa káká wá yi ami glɔ́n tɛn e nɔ hɛn ami balíi 55.000 é (liva 2.3 litli ).
text_en: The valves opening allowed a pressure release for the system and oil flowed on a pad to a tank that can hold 55,000 barrels (2.3 million gallons).

text: Zozo e ɖo ami gbɔ́nnú ɔ́ xomɛ é wɛ ná kó zɔ́n bɔ ali e ɖo wutú tɔn lɛ́ɛ é vlɔ́n, bɔ káká jɛ azǎngagbe hwelɛ́kɔ ɔ́, ami ɔ́ kpoɖo kunkun wɛ.
text_en: As of Wednesday afternoon, the tank vents were still leaking probably from thermal expansion inside the tank.

text: Ami glɔ́ntɛn tejɛmɛtɔn ɖěvó tíin ɖo ami glɔ́nnú glɔ́, bó hɛn ɔ́, é ná hɛn ami gangbá 104.500, bɔ éyɛ ka ko gɔ bǐ ǎ.
text_en: Another secondary containment area below the tanks capable of holding 104,500 barrels was not yet filled to capacity.

text: Azɔn nukɔn tɔn ɔ́ nɛ, bɔ xóɖɔdóxówú tlɔlɔ ɖo gbaví nukpɛ́n nɔ ɔ́ jí, ɖo ɖiɖɔ wɛ ɖɔ tonukún Iláan to ɔ́ tɔn lɛ́ɛ yí gbe ɖɔ yě mɔ tódɔnnúmɛ lɛ́ɛ sín xɔxɔ.
text_en: The comments, live on television, were the first time that senior Iranian sources have admitted that the sanctions are having any effect.

text: Tódɔnnúmɛ e kunkplá akwɛ́zínkan lɛ́ɛ é lɔ ɖ’émɛ, kpódó sɛ́n e Kplékplé Elɔpu tɔn dó, ɖɔ é ma sɔ́ kun kalozíin bluju ɔ́ ɖe sín Iláan to ɔ́ mɛ ó é kpó. Finɛ wɛ akwɛ́ 80% nɔ gosín togúdó wá nú Iláan to ɔ́ lɛ́ɛ ka nɔ tɔ́n sín.
text_en: They include financial restrictions and a ban by the European Union on the export of crude oil, from which the Iranian economy receives 80% of its foreign income.

text: Ɖo Gbeɖiɖówema bɔ gudogudo tɔn dìn e é nɔ bló sunmɛ é mɛ ɔ́, gbɛta OPEP tɔn ɔ́ ɖo ɖiɖɔ wɛ ɖɔ, sín xwè ko ɖíe ɔ́, kalozíin bluju sa dó togúdó j’ayí bǐ, bó wá kpónú balíi lǐví 2,8 gbè ɖokpo.
text_en: In its most recent monthly report, OPEC said exports of crude had fallen to their lowest level for two decades at 2.8 million barrels per day.

text: Gǎn e kpa acɛ nú Iláan to ɔ́ é, Ayatollah Ali Khamenei wá mɔ ɖɔ, lěe é nyí gbɔn bɔ to ɔ́ sín gbɛ bǐ wa ɖo kalozíin lɔmɛ nɛ́ é ɔ́, “mɔ” ɖé wɛ ényí bó ko ɖo te sín huzu-húzú Malɛto Iláan tɔn ɔ́ hwenu ɖo xwe 1979, bɔ to ɔ́ ka ɖó ná tɔ́n sín mɛ.
text_en: The country's supreme leader, Ayatollah Ali Khamenei, has described the dependency on oil as "a trap" dating from before Iran's Islamic revolution in 1979 and from which the country should free itself.

text: Hwenu e Zohún e nɔ yi sunmɛ é lɛ́kɔ ja ayǐkúngban jí, bó kpo ɖo jɔhɔ́n mɛ, Gan 5 mɛ zǎnzǎn é ɔ́ (Gan e nɔ xo ɖo hwetɔ́nwají é), nǔ e nɔte kpɔ́n mǐ ɖe ɔ́ wɛ nyí ɖɔ, éní vlɛ́ kantata wězizanɔ ɖé nú mɛ ɖěɖee ɖo Kalifɔnia totaligbé dɔn lɛ́ɛ é, Olɛgɔń, Nɛvada, kpódó Utáa kpó.
text_en: When the capsule gets to Earth and enters the atmosphere, at about 5am (eastern time), it is expected to put on quite a light show for folks in Northern California, Oregon, Nevada, and Utah.

text: Sunmɛyihún ɔ́ ná cí sunví e nɔ dín gbɔn jǐxwé laa lɛ́ɛ é ɖɔhun titeungbe.
text_en: The capsule will look much like a shooting star going across the sky.

text: Ɖo nukúnxwíxwe ɖokpó mɛ ɔ́, é na nɔ bló alijlɛkpo 12,8 alɔ nǔjlɛ́kpo 8 mɔ. Wezun tɔn ná syɛ́n ɖésú, bɔ é ná sixú gosín san Flánsiko wá yi Losu Anjélɛsi to ɔ́ mɛ, ɖo cɛ́jú ɖokpó mɛ.
text_en: The capsule will be traveling at about 12.8 km or 8 miles per second, fast enough to go from San Francisco to Los Angeles in one minute.

text: Sunmɛyihún sitadusi ɔ́, wezun e sunmɛyihún ɖé má kán kpɔ́n gbeɖě ǎ é wɛ é ná kán, bó ná nyí sunmɛyihún e yáwu lɛ́kɔ wá ayǐkungbanjí hú ɖe lɛ́ɛ bǐ é. Énɛ́ ɔ́, é ná lɛ́ jɛ nukɔn nú sunmɛyihún Apolo X, nǔxwásun 1969 tɔn ɔ́.
text_en: Stardust will set a new all-time record for being the fastest spacecraft to return to Earth, breaking the previous record set in May of 1969 during the return of the Apollo X command module.

text: “Gǎn e kpa acɛ nú titomɛ sitadusinɛ́ ɔ́ tɔn é, Tomu Dusibuli, ɖɔ jí é ná ɖisa gbɔn xutó e ɖo hweyixɔ nú kalifɔní sín taligbe é, bó ná tá wězíza gbɔn kalifɔnia sín jǐnukúnsin, ɖo olɛgɔn to ɔ́ sín tɛ́ntin, gbɔn nɛvada kpódó Idaho kpó, bó ná lɛ́ gbɔn Utaa”.
text_en: “It will move over the west coast of northern California and will light the sky from California through central Oregon and on through Nevada and Idaho and into Utah,” Tom Duxbury, Stardust's project manager said.

text: Gběra e Mɛdaxó Rudi sɔ́ dɔ gbekɔndókpɔ́ sín wěma e é bló do kyoto, bɔ é dɔ xó dó lěe kɛ́ ɔ́ mɛ nɔ́ cí gbɔn é wú ɔ́, émí ná d’alɔ mɛ é, zɔ́n bɔ Amelíka to ‘’Etats-Unis’ ɔ́ ẃ jɛ édokpónɔ, bo nyí to hunnukún dokpó géé é ma d’alɔ wěma mɔ̌hun mɛ ǎ é.
text_en: Mr. Rudd's decision to sign the Kyoto climate accord isolates the United States, which will now be the only developed nation not to ratify the agreement.

text: Acɛkpíkpa xóxó Ɔsitlali to ɔ́ tɔ gbɛ́ dɔ émí kún ná d’ lɔ kyoto sín wěma ɔ́ mɛ ó. Ɖó é táa wa nǔ dó akwɛzínkan to émí tɔn wú. É díe to émí tɔn sín akwɛ́zínkan ɔ́, aǐkúngbanlanmɛ sín dɔkun akan sísa jí wɛ é jínjɔ́n. To dé lɛ́ɛ, di Ɛndi to ɔ́, kpǒdǒ Cínu to ɔ́ kpó dɔhun ɔ́, kan énɛ́ de ka blá yédɛ́ɛ ǎ.
text_en: Australia's former conservative government refused to ratify Kyoto, saying it would damage the economy with its heavy reliance on coal exports, while countries like India and China were not bound by emissions targets.

text: Ɖo ‘’eBay’’ sín tan ɔ mɛ ɔ́, nú e hugǎn nǔ bǐ bɔ é yi ɔ́ nɛ́.
text_en: It is the biggest acquisition in eBay's history.

text: Azɔxwé ɔ́ ɖo nukún ɖó wɛ ɖɔ émi ná wa nǔ, bɔ fi e akwɛ nɔ gosín wá nú émí lɛ́ɛ ná sukpɔ́, bɔ to ná tuun émí gbɔn fí ɖěɖee ‘’Skype’’ ɖo tɛ́n ɖaxó mɛ ɖe lɛ́ɛ é. Ɖi cínú, Elɔpu ɖo hwetɔ́n waji, kpódó Blezilu to ɔ́ kpó ɖɔhun.
text_en: The company hopes to diversify its profit sources and gain popularity in areas where Skype holds a strong position, such as China, Eastern Europe, and Brazil.

text: Nǔnywɛ́ xwítíxwítíwatɔ́ lɛ́ɛ mɔ dó ɛnceladu wú ɖɔ é ɖó hlɔ̌nhlɔ́n dó ayǐkúngan ɔ́ jí, bó sixú kó nyí fíe hwɛkan láglásinɔ E “saturne” tɔn ɔ́ wú kun sín é.
text_en: Scientists have suspected Enceladus as geologically active and a possible source of Saturn's icy E ring.

text_en: Enceladus is the most reflective object in the solar system, reflecting about 90 percent of the sunlight that hits it.

text_en: The game is based on the Second Battle of Fallujah, a vicious battle between American and Iraqi forces.

text_en: The U.S. says it has received information from an undisclosed source that specifically mentions the use of suicide bombers to will blow up "prominent landmarks" in Ethiopia and Kenya.

text: Jɛnukɔn nú “ The Daily Show” kpódó “ The Cobert Report” kpó ɔ́, Hɛki kpódó Jɔnsɔnu kpó ko ɖo linlin wɛ ɖɔ, yě ná ɖe wěma ɖé tɔn, dó vlɛ́ hwenu e yě ɖo kpɔ́nyijibɔalavɔ-vi nyí wɛ ɖo UW ɖo léxwélé 1988 é, sín hwenuxó wěma lɛ́ɛ, kpódó xójlátɔ́ lɛ́ɛ sín azɔ̌ wa dó wěma jí lɛ́ɛ kpó.
text_en: Long before The Daily Show and The Colbert Report, Heck and Johnson envisioned a publication that would parody the news—and news reporting—when they were students at UW in 1988.

text: Sín hwenu é jɔ e ɔ́, wěma “The Onion” wá húzú nǔ e nɔ ɖo jijɛ wɛ din lɛ́ɛ é sín wěgbó titeungbe ɖokpó, bɔ yě tlɛ ko zín akpáxwé tɔn ɖokpó, bó ɖó ɛntɛnɛti sín gɔnu ɖokpó, bɔ é dɔn gbɛtɔ́ 5,000,000 ɖo kɔ́nyásun ɔ́ mɛ. Bɔ yě yi kpɔ́n ajɔ́jlájlá mɛɖésúnɔ tɔn lɛ́ɛ, xó-xwlémɛ ganxixo 24 tɔn lɛ́ɛ, nǔsɔ́ dó ɛntɛnɛti jí lɛ́ɛ, kpódó gbɛ ɔ́ sín ɖiɖe dó atɛjí e é nyí kan ná yɔ̌yɔ̌ din, bɔ é nɔ nyí “Our Dumb World” ɔ́ kpó.
text_en: Since its inception, The Onion has become a veritable news parody empire, with a print edition, a website that drew 5,000,000 unique visitors in the month of October, personal ads, a 24 hour news network, podcasts, and a recently launched world atlas called Our Dumb World.

text_en: Many of their writers have gone on to wield great influence on Jon Stewart and Stephen Colbert's news parody shows.

text_en: The artistic event is also part of a campaign by the Bucharest City Hall that seeks to relaunch the image of the Romanian capital as a creative and colourful metropolis.
